what_it_is: Agent Harbor (Lodestar) daily cost cap drill. The drill ran the echo agent on its stub model, not the analyst and not a real model; the dollar figures are what the same tokens would cost at a list price.
title: Daily cost cap reached
did: Set the daily cap to $0.000013 (about one stub run), ran one small run, then a padded one, then another.
expected: The first run completes under the cap; the second is stopped at a step boundary when its own cost crosses the cap; the third is refused with 429 and the reason before any work.
observed: run 2: `stopped`, reason `cost_cap`: stopped at a step boundary: the daily cost cap is spent: $0.000274 of $0.000013 today
run 3: HTTP 429, reason `cost_cap`: the daily cost cap is spent: $0.000274 of $0.000013 today

refusal.detail: the daily cost cap is spent: $0.000274 of $0.000013 today
